title: Motional and MIT AI explains self-driving car decisions
summary: Motional and MIT researchers developed an explainable AI system for self-driving cars that provides real-time decision explanations, addressing the 'black-box' problem in autonomous vehicle AI. The research, published in Nature, aims to make autonomous vehicle decision-making transparent and interpretable.
problem_solved: The black-box problem in autonomous vehicle AI where decision-making processes are opaque and unexplainable to humans.
why_valuable: It enables transparency and trust in self-driving technology, which is essential for safety certification, regulatory approval, and public acceptance of autonomous vehicles.
